Quokka chemical yield datatables

This archive contains generated Quokka DataTable CSV files, not the original
stellar yield tables or MIST tracks.

Files:
- SNII_yield_table.csv
  1D Quokka DataTable. Source: solar-metallicity Sukhbold et al. (2016)
  massive-star yield tables, explosive ejecta column.

- WR_yield_table.csv
  1D Quokka DataTable. Source: solar-metallicity Sukhbold et al. (2016)
  massive-star yield tables, wind column.

- AGB_yield_table.csv
  1D Quokka DataTable. Source: Karakas--Lugaro AGB yields plus Doherty et al.
  super-AGB yields.

- WR_mass_loss_distribution_table.csv
  2D Quokka DataTable. Source: solar-metallicity MIST tracks. The table stores
  cumulative WR mass-loss fraction versus stellar age and birth mass, with the
  WR phase identified by surface_h1 < 0.4. It distributes the integrated WR
  isotope budget in time; it is not itself an isotope yield table.
